text:
Carol will likely win. The "as is" clause disclaims only implied warranties, and the 1964 model year in the newspaper ad and the website photo are express affirmations of fact that formed part of the basis of the bargain, so the seller breached an express warranty and may have committed fraud. Her likely remedy is rescission or damages equal to the difference between the 1964 and 1968 values, and the parol evidence rule does not bar proof of those prior representations.

CONFIDENCE: 74
